description: This file defines an abstract class 'BasicWidgetConfigComponent' for widget configuration in an Angular application, including methods for setup, validation, and data key construction, along with related interfaces and types.

classes.name: IBasicWidgetConfigComponent
classes.description: Interface for basic widget configuration components, including properties and validation method.

classes.name: BasicWidgetConfigComponent
classes.description: Abstract class providing common functionality for widget configuration components, including setup, validation, and data key management.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Initializes widget configuration, setting defaults and timewindow if applicable, and sets up validators and value change subscriptions.

methods.name: setupDefaults
methods.description: Sets default data keys for the widget configuration based on provided functions or defaults.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Returns default data keys; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: defaultLatestDataKeys
methods.description: Returns default latest data keys; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators; implementation is empty in this abstract class.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control paths that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: onConfigChanged
methods.description: Emits updated widget configuration when changes occur.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the output widget configuration; can be overridden.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the form; returns true if valid.

methods.name: setupDefaultDatasource
methods.description: Initializes data sources and data keys in the widget configuration.

methods.name: constructDataKey
methods.description: Constructs a DataKey object with specified properties, using callbacks.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Abstract method to get the form group; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Abstract method to handle configuration setup; to be implemented in subclasses.
